title: SpeakIt
text:
Done — the flip is implemented, built, installed, and running. PR #13 on branch feature/micro-player-click-controls (renamed from the placeholder to match the work).

New micro-circle behavior:
Left-click → play/pause (no longer expands).
Right-click → opens the full player directly (no menu on the circle anymore).
Right-click again on the expanded player → the options menu (transcript / minimize / close / quit), which was already there.
Hover now shows the play/pause glyph that the click will trigger, and the tooltip says click: play/pause · right-click: open.
Drag-to-move still works (a real drag, ≥4px), so a plain click reads as pause, not a move.

The right-click is caught by a small AppKit overlay that only grabs right-mouse events and lets left-clicks/drags fall through — so pausing and moving still behave.

Please give it a try: start something playing, and in the small circle left-click to pause/resume, right-click to open. Two things I couldn't automate headlessly and would love you to confirm: (1) left-click reliably pauses (doesn't accidentally expand), and (2) right-click opens without popping the old menu. If anything feels off, tell me and I'll adjust on this branch before we merge.
